reviews.title: Amazing graphics card.
reviews.comment: Amazing gpu, amazing features, loving AMD drivers and softwares. Incredible value for money and it’s quiet. And 12 vram does miracles
reviews.author: Juan Bonett

reviews.title: awesome card
reviews.comment: Love the card. Other models of similar spec are double the price. I’ve been running GTAV on the highest settings and Assetto Corsa in VR perfectly fine. Performs fantastic. Temps stay cool. Only thing I wish was different is the white led ambient lighting. I can’t change it to match my case lights, but it’s still a great looking and performing card.
reviews.author: Lucas Kidder

reviews.title: Amazing GPU!!!
reviews.comment: This graphics card is amazing I use it for mainly competitive gaming in overwatch and it runs on my 3440x1440 Monitor amazing I get around 200 fps and 100fps on other games. Install is easy and is very much worth the money, though in my set up it’s a little loud it doesn’t go through my headphones.
reviews.author: Christian martinez

reviews.title: Powerful
reviews.comment: The amount of power you get from stepping up to this card from the 7600 is insane its overkill on 1080p and runs everything good at 1440p I got this card for 300 super good steal
reviews.author: Dylan Petty

reviews.title: Fine, but maybe outdated
reviews.comment: Good for the price I got it, but may be outdated already depending on your perspective as there are arguments that the 9060xt is a better purchase (if you can find it at MSRP as at the time of this review it was at min $50 more expensive and who knows with the ram crisis if it'll get worse or better). Best to review the two if they are close in price to make the best desicion for yourself before completing purchase. Performance otherwise is fine and better than my 6750xt I had but with Code Vein its still not enough to run consistant 60fps at 50% resolution FSR. Unoptimized UE5 games aside, this thing will run everything else.
